name: EVIE (8B teacher and 4.5B Prefix-MRL)

lineage.base_model: Qwen3.5-9B (EVIE-8B) and Qwen3.5-4B (EVIE-4.5B) per the card table
lineage.how_derived: ColQwen3.5-style late-interaction retriever; EVIE-4.5B is distilled from the 8B teacher with relation and margin distillation (card)

purpose: Most accurate visual document retriever on ViDoRe according to the builder: multi-vector late-interaction embeddings of page images that keep layout, typography, charts and tables; the 4.5B student adds Prefix-MRL dimensions (64 to 2048) and training-free HAC token compression for cheaper storage (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0 (Tencent LICENSE, third-party components excepted)
license.notes: LICENSE of EVIE-8B read at its head: EVIE (code, parameters, weights) is Apache-2.0 except listed third-party components; full Apache-2.0 text follows.

architecture.kind: late-interaction (ColBERT-style, MaxSim) visual document retriever on Qwen3.5 with bidirectional full attention; per-token embeddings
architecture.why_this_design: Card: per-token multi-vector embeddings avoid the information loss of single-vector compression and preserve spatial layout, typography and tables; bidirectional attention lets vision patches and prompt tokens interact. 8B uses 4096-dimensional token vectors; 4.5B (4.54B to 4.61B in card tables) offers 64 to 2048 dimensions by Prefix-MRL.

variants.notes: 4.54B parameters, 1.6k downloads on the HF API

pc-12gb.notes: 8B BF16 (16.9 GB) needs a quant or offload; index storage grows with page count x tokens x dimension

engine_support.notes: Qwen3.5 vision-language backbone with late-interaction heads; llama.cpp support for multi-vector scoring not verified.

benchmarks.name: ViDoRe V3 Mean (Task) on the ViDoRe leaderboard
benchmarks.harness: card quotes the official leaderboard; leaderboard page not opened by us

strengths: 4.5B student is within 0.7 nDCG@10 of the 8B on ViDoRe V3 per the card
Prefix-MRL (64 to 2048 dimensions) and HAC token compression reduce index size
weaknesses: Multi-vector index is much larger than single-vector embeddings (4096 dimensions per token for the 8B)
Numbers are the builder's own table (leaderboard rank quoted, not verified by us)
Language coverage and German performance not stated in the card parts read
Card headline calls it 'the most accurate', marketing tone
best_for: page-image document search (PDFs, slides, charts) without OCR
soft.maturity: Tencent; arXiv 2610.11553 and a GitHub repo with training code; 8B 294 and 4.5B 1.6k downloads on the HF API (low adoption so far).

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0 and a 4.5B model that fits every hardware class gives a strong OCR-free document retriever for the documents area; needs a German-document test, a late-interaction index design and a check of the leaderboard claim before an offer.
blockers: late-interaction scoring and multi-vector index not in Tona
Qwen3.5 vision tower with bidirectional attention variant

sources.note: referenced by the card, not opened
